hooks.command: ~/.config/tmux/agent-sidebar/scripts/agent-state.sh working
~/.config/tmux/agent-sidebar/scripts/agent-state.sh done
[ -n "${T3CODE_THREAD_ID-}" ] && ~/.claude/scripts/t3-delete-subagents.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
~/.config/tmux/agent-sidebar/scripts/agent-state.sh waiting
~/.config/tmux/agent-sidebar/scripts/agent-state.sh end
rtk hook claude
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/commit-gate.sh
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/push-gate.sh
case "$CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT" in sdk*|t3-code) PLANNOTATOR_DATA_DIR='/Users/barziv/.plannotator' '/Users/barziv/.local/bin/plannotator' t3-hook;; esac
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/graphify-trial.sh search
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/graphify-trial.sh read
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/plan-written.sh
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/graphify-trial.sh start
~/.claude/scripts/hooks/graphify-trial.sh compact

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
